audio_role: Comedic upbeat track with no voice and no sizzle. Three small pop accents land as left burger, middle burger, right burger appear 0-3.08s. A whoosh covers the whip at 3.08s. A hard final hit lands exactly on the logo cut at 4.88s and holds under the end card.
can_make: We cannot make the real trick. Shot 1: from a real final burger menu photo we can fake three stills side-by-side with hard pop-cuts left to right, plus zoom and pop sounds in edit, but a 4s AI clip started from a photo cannot hold three buns locked in place while patties, melted cheese and lettuce grow without warping. Shot 2: house cast AI model can stand and hold a bottle and pose, never eating, but cannot do the fast whip from table to bottle-to-mouth without hands and face melting. Shot 3: we can remake exactly in edit - black card with white logo and same music hit. The seamless before-after build and the bottle gag need a real shoot.
core: Bare bottom buns turn into tall double burgers one by one as if the cook's sauce bottle is building them by magic.
dish: double cheeseburger with melted cheese and lettuce
fits: Dishes that start from a plain base and finish tall and layered where the change reads in one glance: burgers, sandwiches, tacos, hot dogs, loaded fries, pizza with toppings added in steps.
hook: Table-level macro of three bare buns sharp on steel in first second while a blurred cook behind aims a sauce bottle at camera.
needs_camera: A locked-off real camera low on a real steel counter in a real kitchen, real buns swapped for real built burgers between hidden cuts, a real cook timing both hands on a real squeeze bottle, and the fast real whip push from burgers to his face with bottle tip to mouth. Stable reflections, identical framing, and synced hands are what sell it.
people: One man in his 30s in black t-shirt and backward black cap standing behind the counter. He holds a white squeeze bottle with yellow sauce in both hands, points and pretends to work magic, then brings the tip to his mouth like a trumpet as camera rushes to him.

shots.action: Three bottom buns on steel turn into three double cheeseburgers one by one left to right
Cook brings sauce bottle tip to his mouth as if blowing it
White burger icon and text logo appears on black

text_on_screen: No text for 0-4.88s. From 4.88-6.5s white on black: bitten burger icon with .fat. BURGER.
why_it_works: You see dry bare buns become full burgers with two brown patties, dripping yellow cheese and green lettuce in 3 seconds, close and glossy with reflections on steel. The before-after is instant and the cheese pull and height show fat and freshness.
source: reference reel (link removed: we study the edit, never use the footage)
